Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the phosphorus content in dishwashing detergent.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the phosphorus content in dishwashing detergent;and amending RCW 70.95L.020.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 70.95L.020 and 2006 c 223 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) After July 1, 1994, a person may not sell or distribute forsale a laundry detergent that contains 0.5 percent or more phosphorusby weight. (2)(a) After July 1, 1994, and until the dates specified in (b) ofthis subsection, a person may not sell or distribute for sale adishwashing detergent that contains 8.7 percent or more ((phosphorous[phosphorus])) phosphorus by weight. (b) A person may not sell or distribute for sale a dishwashingdetergent that contains 0.5 percent or more phosphorus by weight: (i) Commencing July 1, 2008, in counties located east of the crestof the Cascade mountains with populations, as determined by office offinancial management population estimates((: (A) Greater than one hundred eighty thousand and less than twohundred twenty thousand; and p. 1 HB 2263 (B))), greater than three hundred ninety thousand and less than sixhundred ((fifty)) thousand; (ii) Commencing July 1, 2010, throughout the state. (3) This section does not apply to the sale or distribution ofdetergents for commercial and industrial uses.
